why: Pre-1996 spelling. Duden has written this as two words with a capital Rad since the reform, because Rad is a noun object and not a prefix. The one-word form also made the conjugator generate «du radfahrst» and «geradfahrt» — impossible German — with reliable:true, so the drill would have printed it. As «Rad fahren» the space guard marks it unreliable and the drill skips it, which is correct until the generator can split a two-word verb.
